description: Set one environment variable on the linked Rebase Cloud project (`rebase cloud env set KEY --stdin`). The value is written through stdin, never put on a command line, and never returned; `secret: true` makes it write-only. It applies on the next deploy. Production's needs `confirm: true` (previews' does not): the first call says what it would change.

confirm.description: true once the user has agreed to exactly this. Without it the tool says what it would do and does nothing

preview.description: Set it for the project's previews only; production keeps its value

project.description: The project to act on: a registered project's name (rebase_project_list), or a Rebase Cloud project's slug or id. Optional when the session's directory is linked to the intended project. Refused when it names a different project than the directory's link.

secret.description: Write-only: it can be replaced and used, never read back

name: rebase_cloud_env_set
